correctness.rationale: Exact trigonometric weights, uniform Dirichlet cyclic gap density, three equal singular corners, homogeneous two-variable area integral with leading 2 sqrt(2) per corner, and O(1/T) remaining strips prove precisely 3 sqrt(2)/pi^2. Finite diagnostics are not used as infinite proof.
